content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to install [product_name] [version_no] on a Mac? I'm having trouble with this on macOS Monterey [version_no].

I managed to get [version_no] working on Monterey after updating from Mojave, where it was already running. Strangely, the latest download from [company_name] did not work, but an older downloaded installer still functions, even though it’s the same [version_no]. I had a previous download saved from Mojave and this installed without issues. Alternatively, you can copy the entire installation folder from another Mac and it should work. I experienced problems opening project files because Apple now restricts app access to folders. In Security & Privacy preferences, granting the app full disk access allowed me to open projects. There may be safer configuration options, but I couldn't find a way to add additional folders to the app using the folder access setting. Hopefully this helps others facing similar difficulties.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report problems installing [product_name] [version_no] on macOS Monterey, especially when using the latest installer from [company_name]. An older installer can still be used successfully. After installation, macOS privacy controls restrict the app from accessing files, requiring users to grant full disk access to resolve these issues.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy installation process for [product_name] [version_no] on macOS Monterey and smooth access to project files, without needing to change security settings.
